export type WorkspaceExternalWriteProvenance = "trusted-system" | "direct-operator" | "external" | "derived" | "invalid" | "missing" | string
function evaluate... accepts source directly or object `{provenance}` / `{source}` / `{origin}`.

Allowed values `"trusted" | "operator"` plus maybe `"trusted-system" | "direct-operator"` but latter could be seen alternate policy. Prompt says trusted/operator, likely source values.
